frozen_at: 2026-10-08T17:20+03:00 (approved; final version frozen before any sample MVM)
approval: Alex approved the gate revision INCLUDING the scale-aware absolute floor (point 3).
scope: Remote BoardSimulator only (192.168.88.245, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3,4,5); no physical board; no official test set; no 16-checkpoint hybrid; single Conv1 layer of the frozen wide-BNTT checkpoint. Do NOT touch GPU0-2 (3090, user diliara's job).
objective: Validate the Conv1 differential mapping across the full per-filter signal-variance range via a stratified 14-filter sample, under a variance-aware gate.

stratified_filters.selection_rule: 3 filters per ideal_sd_val quartile, spanning within-quartile min/mid/max; plus continuity anchors 0 and 1
stratified_filters.notes: filter 0 = prior full-pipeline pass (sd 0.2084); filter 1 = prior stage-32 failure (full sd 0.1358, tile0 sd 0.0816)

full75_gate_PER_REPLICATE.scale_aware_floor: 0.05 * maxabs_w(filter); maxabs_w = max |Conv1 weight| of that filter

gate_revision.rationale: The stage-32 gate previously applied Pearson/RMSE to the 32-tap partial output, whose variance can be much lower than the full filter (filter 1: tile0 sd 0.0816 vs full 0.1358), so a relative RMSE threshold on a low-variance partial output is ill-posed. The functional gate now applies only to the full 75-tap aggregated output; the scale-aware floor guards genuinely low-variance filters (full SD floor 0.106 => 0.6*SD ~= 0.0636 sits near measured write-noise RMSE ~0.06).

mapping: G+ = 0.03 + 0.02*w/maxabs75, G- = 0.03 - 0.02*w/maxabs75 on 32x8 BoardSimulator, 2 differential columns per tile, 3 tiles (0-32, 32-64, 64-75); reconstruction (col0-col1)*maxabs75/(0.04*0.3).
safety: Before every MVM: requested and decoded voltage <=0.3V (no clipping), observed+actual resistances finite positive, predicted sum(decoded_V/R) STRICT <15mA; ADC saturation abort. Programming pulses (up to ~3V) separate from inference limit. Simulator-only BoardSimulator connector.

resources.note: BoardSimulator is CPU-bound; pin GPUs 3-5 (3070) explicitly if any tensor path uses GPU; never touch 0-2 (3090, diliara).

advancement: If >=13/14 filters pass (all 3 replicates each), and anchor filter 1 passes at full-75 level, report and await Alex's next decision (full 64 vs 16-checkpoint hybrid). Any failure requires parent review; no in-place retry, no post-hoc threshold change.
